title: Random Boolean coefficient sample equivalence
statement: For a natural number $n$ and a subset $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$, there is a bijection from the Boolean functions on the $n$-dimensional cube with values in the two integer units to functions from a set of size $2^n$ to the two integer units, obtained by reindexing cube inputs and multiplying each output by the parity sign on $S$ at the corresponding input.
